boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented Sonoma State activities with no admission or purchase required for the stated eligible audience.

cards.title: Big Nite
cards.subtitle: Parking Lot D · Sonoma State University
cards.notes: Bring an SSU ID or proof of attendance to check in, then spend the evening on rides, at the student-org fair, or listening to the DJ set.
cards.short_summary: An SSU student welcome-night carnival with free rides, food, and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Associated Students lists Big Nite on August 23, 2026 and says it is free for students with SSU ID or proof of attendance, including food and rides.
cards.source_title: Big Nite | Associated Students at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Student-only free access; bring SSU Student ID or proof of attendance to the check-in booth.

cards.title: Join a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Niagara and Silver Strand studios · Campus Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the posted class schedule, choose a session that fits, and arrive ready to participate; offerings are designed for all fitness levels.
cards.short_summary: Instructor-led fitness sessions offered without a class charge to eligible participants.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation states that Group Fitness classes are free for students and members and are held in the Niagara and Silver Strand studios.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness | Campus Recreation at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Free for current students and Campus Recreation members; offered during the academic school year.

cards.title: Play Intramural Sports
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center and practice fields
cards.notes: Create or join a team through IMLeagues, or register as a free agent if you want the program to help place you with a team.
cards.short_summary: A free campus league program for eligible Seawolves and Rec Center members.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation states that Intramural Sports are free and that students can create or join a team or sign up as a free agent.
cards.source_title: Intramural Sports | Campus Recreation at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Limited to current enrolled students, faculty, staff, and registered alumni who are Rec Center members.

cards.title: Take a Recreation Swim
cards.subtitle: Aquatics Pool · near Wolves' Den
cards.notes: Check pool hours before going, bring a Seawolf ID, and use the lap or recreation-swim time with a lifeguard on duty.
cards.short_summary: Eligible students can use the ten-lane campus pool for lap or recreation swimming.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation says pool access is free for students eligible for membership through student fees and requires a Seawolf ID for admittance.
cards.source_title: Aquatics | Campus Recreation at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Free only for students eligible through student fees; bring Seawolf ID and confirm swim hours, which currently show closed.

cards.title: Register for Campus Esports
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center · RecPortal
cards.notes: Watch Campus Recreation announcements for the next registration window, then choose the division that matches your experience before signing up.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Recreation esports program with beginner and experienced divisions.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation's esports registration notice describes two divisions and states that the program was free with no cost for that season.
cards.source_title: Esports - Registration Deadline | Campus Recreation at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: The cited no-cost notice is for the 2025 season; verify that a new session is scheduled before registering.

cards.title: Attend a Gender, Race, & Justice Lecture
cards.subtitle: Stevenson 1202 · Sonoma State University
cards.notes: Check the department's series page for the next speaker, then drop into Stevenson 1202 for a focused afternoon talk and discussion.
cards.short_summary: A Women’s and Gender Studies speaker series open without charge to students and the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The Women's and Gender Studies Department states that all Gender, Race, & Justice Lecture Series lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: WGS Lecture Series | Women's and Gender Studies at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the cited schedule is Spring 2026, so confirm future dates with the department.

cards.entity_name: Geography, Environment, and Planning Research Colloquium
cards.title: Catch the GEP Research Colloquium
cards.subtitle: Stevenson Hall 1202 · Sonoma State University
cards.notes: Check the speaker list, then bring a classmate for a compact midday research talk in Stevenson Hall followed by conversation on the topic.
cards.short_summary: A public geography, environment, and planning talk series at Sonoma State.
cards.evidence_claim: The Geography, Environment, and Planning Department describes its Research Colloquium as free and open to the public and the entire SSU community.
cards.source_title: Research Colloquium (GEP 311) | Geography, Environment, and Planning at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the cited page lists a Spring 2025 schedule, so verify a current session before visiting.

cards.title: Go to the Community Writers Festival
cards.subtitle: Student Center and campus locations · Sonoma State University
cards.notes: When the festival returns, start at the Student Center for the program, then choose a reading, panel, or collaborative-writing workshop to attend.
cards.short_summary: A campus literary festival featuring readings, panels, workshops, and a community bazaar.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State's English Department states that the Sonoma Community Writers Festival is free and open to the public and requires no registration.
cards.source_title: Festival FAQ | Department of English at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public with no registration required; check the festival page for its next date.

cards.title: Watch the Japanese Language Speech Contest
cards.subtitle: Student Center Ballrooms B & C · Sonoma State University
cards.notes: Attend as an audience member to hear prepared speeches and stay for the awards ceremony; participant registration is separate from attending.
cards.short_summary: A public Sonoma State speech contest and awards gathering centered on Japanese language.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State's Academic Affairs page lists the Japanese Language Speech Contest admission as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Japanese Language Speech Contest | Division of Academic Affairs at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Admission is free and open to the public; the cited contest date was October 28, 2025, so confirm a future event date.

cards.title: See the 2026 BFA Exhibition
cards.subtitle: University Art Gallery · Art Building
cards.notes: Visit the University Art Gallery during its exhibition run to look through the graduating BFA cohort's painting, printmaking, and photography work.
cards.short_summary: A free University Art Gallery exhibition presenting graduating BFA students' studio work.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State announced that the 2026 BFA Exhibition and its opening reception were free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The University Art Gallery at Sonoma State University presents 2026 BFA exhibition | SSU News
cards.access_notes: The cited exhibition ran April 23–May 23, 2026 and was free; check the gallery calendar for the current exhibition.
